contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [FL IVL]CONSTANTIVS NOB C ; R/ PROVIDEN [TIAE CAESS]

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Providentiae Caess issue of 324-330, Reece period 16, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: [FL IVL]CONSTANTIVS NOB C. Reverse description: Camp gate with two towers, one star over. Reverse inscription: PROVIDEN [TIAE CAESS]. In exergue: PTR. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin.…
